questions.question: No design doc found for this branch. Run /office-hours first for sharper review input, or proceed directly with the CEO review?

options.label: Run /office-hours first
options.description: Produces a structured problem statement, premise challenge, and explored alternatives — gives this review much sharper input. Takes ~10 minutes.

options.label: Proceed with standard review
options.description: Skip /office-hours and review the plan as-is. Recommended when the problem statement is already clear and the plan is ready to interrogate. (recommended)
